notes.title: Help Menu Fix
notes.content: Fixed - Game wouldn't autosave via the Help Menu when you go back to the main menu. It would work if you do it when pressing Esc.

notes.title: Day 1 Patch
notes.content:
Fixed - An issue with being able to drop the coins onto other character.
Fixed - Issue where quest for Well Read would retrigger once completed.
Fixed - When going to bed in evening, you were able to leave the RV causing you not to be able to sleep.
